info.title: egov.js API Wire Contract
info.description: Wire-level OpenAPI contract for the Philippine eGov services implemented by egov.js. Each operation declares the documented provider host used by generated API examples; consumers can override it when targeting another environment.

post.description: The digest is the lowercase hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 of `amount|txnid`. Use the X-eGovPay-Token value as the HMAC key, but remove a leading `test_` staging prefix before signing; production tokens are used unchanged.

403.description: Partner credentials are invalid or unauthorized.

422.description: Exchange code is invalid, used, or expired.

401.description: Access token is missing, invalid, or expired.

200.description: OTP confirmed and view token returned.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token issued by the relevant service.

XApiKey.name: x-api-key
XApiKey.description: API key used by Compass and Face Liveness.

EgovPayApiKey.name: X-eGovPay-Token
EgovPayApiKey.description: eGovPay merchant token. Send the complete token in this header. Only digest computation strips a leading `test_` prefix.

EReportViewApiKey.name: X-EReport-View-Token
EReportViewApiKey.description: Report view token returned by OTP confirmation.

callback_url.description: Required by the provider when action is redirect.

status.description: Known values include FAILED, PENDING, and SUCCEEDED; providers may add values.

digest.description: Lowercase hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 of `amount|txnid`. The key is the merchant token with a leading `test_` prefix removed; production tokens are used unchanged.

scope.description: Known scope: SSO_AUTHENTICATION; providers may add values.
